\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Circuit language and circuit value]
\lean{BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.mem_language_iff_pairEncode_mem_CVAL}
\label{BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.mem_language_iff_pairEncode_mem_CVAL}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.CVAL, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.encode, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.encode_injective, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.HasFaninTwo, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.language, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.mem_language_iff, Turing.pairEncode, Turing.pairEncode_injective}
\difficulty{4}
Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits in which every circuit has fan-in at most two,
has no repeated arguments at any gate, and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. For
every Boolean string $x$, the family accepts $x$ if and only if the encoding of the
circuit for inputs of length $|x|$, paired with $x$, belongs to the circuit value
language.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Reduction to circuit value]
\lean{BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.IsPUniform.polyTimeReducible_CVAL}
\label{BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.IsPUniform.polyTimeReducible_CVAL}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.CVAL, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.HasFaninTwo, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.IsPUniform, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.language, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.mem_language_iff_pairEncode_mem_CVAL, Complexity.PolyTimeComputable.comp, Complexity.PolyTimeComputable.pairEncode, Complexity.PolyTimeReducible, Complexity.polyTimeComputable_id, Complexity.polyTimeComputable_unary, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{3}
Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits. Suppose $C$ is
polynomial-time-uniform and every circuit in the family is well formed with at most two
inputs to each gate. Then the language accepted by $C$ is polynomial-time many-one
reducible to the Boolean circuit value language for circuits with at most two inputs per
gate.
\end{theorem}

\difficulty{1}
Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits. Suppose $C$ is

\begin{theorem}[P membership from uniform circuits]
\lean{Language.mem_P_of_isPUniform}
\label{Language.mem_P_of_isPUniform}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.HasFaninTwo, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.IsPUniform, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.IsPUniform.language_mem_P, BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.language, Complexity.P}
\difficulty{1}
Let $L$ be a language over the Boolean alphabet, and let $C$ be a family of Boolean
circuits that is polynomial-time uniform and has fan-in at most two. If the language
recognized by $C$ is $L$, then $L$ belongs to polynomial time.
\end{theorem}
